name: Alliance Trauma
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Doctor adventurer, I presume. It is a pleasure to see you.

I have some wonderful news for you! Gustaf VanHowzen, chief physician of Alliance Trauma has made a personal request for you to join him at Theramore. This could be the opportunity of a lifetime! I would give anything to be given a chance to study under the great doctor, Gustaf VanHowzen! Do not squander this opportunity, doctor!
narrative.objectives: Travel to Theramore in the Dustwallow Marsh and speak with Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen about joining the ranks of Alliance Trauma.
narrative.offerRewardText: Wonderful. Put on your scrubs, we are to start at once!
